current_norm_gate: Full Academic Guide under V. V. Lopatin §§140–148, current orthographic dictionary/Gramota for lexical and functional boundaries
normalization_rule: Service-word and НЕ spelling is normalized by current learner decision engines, not by old textbook lists or source paragraph count. Function/homonym examples become branches of the productive owner unless they retain an independent semantic decision not covered by that owner.

pre_wave_cross_domain_correction.reason: The old Grade-7 label grouped ОТТОГО with conjunction contrasts, but current normative analysis treats ОТТОГО primarily as a pronominal adverb; the orthographic contrast ОТТОГО / ОТ ТОГО is owned by the adverb solid-vs-separate engine. The multiword conjunction-like sequence ОТТОГО ЧТО belongs later to complex-subordinator syntax/punctuation, not to a separately counted orthographic conjunction identity.
